summary: Both pilots pass mutually exclusive legacy and wave routing arguments; labeling also loses Arm-B source metadata.
M2 collapses sample cap-hit flags by prompt SHA and overwrites only greedy, leaving truncated sampled responses in the experiment.
Primary labels use an unapproved numeric rubric; predictor censoring has no per-arm accounting or identical-instrument SYNC recovery.
Generation can finish without uploading raw completions before capture or its done sentinel.
Means emits over 10k per-prompt files in one directory despite the registered <=500-prompt consolidated-shard contract.
Pod and fits fingerprints omit multiple consumed artifacts and can resume stale results.
S2 uses row bootstrap, wrong layer/whitening membership, and a draw-average target that omits greedy.
